beats.say: Where did the last app you installed really come from?
Your phone's official app store checks apps before they appear for download.
Apps from random links or websites skip those checks and can hide nasty surprises.
Keep the setting that allows unknown sources turned off unless you truly need it.
Even in the store, read the reviews and check who made the app before installing.
Look at your recent installs today, and send this to someone who downloads everything.
